# Proponitis Fitness

> Premier Gym & Fitness Center in R.S. Puram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Offering Personal Training, Sports Specific Training, Full Body Stretching, Strength & Conditioning, Weight Loss Coaching, and General Memberships.

## About Proponitis Fitness
Proponitis Fitness is a modern, result-driven fitness center located in R.S. Puram, Coimbatore. We provide tailored workout programs, certified personal trainers, state-of-the-art strength and cardio equipment, and a dedicated women's workout slot.

## Location & Contact Information
- Address: Perumal Complex, 74, Ramachandra Rd, R.S. Puram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641002, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9952431546
- Email: support@proponitisfitness.com
- Website: https://proponitisfitness.com

## Operating Hours
- Morning Session: 5:30 AM – 1:30 PM (All Members)
- Women's Special Slot: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
- Evening Session: 4:00 PM – 10:00 PM (All Members)

## Services & Programs
- Personal Training: 1-on-1 dedicated fitness coaching tailored to individual goals, body composition, and fitness levels.
- Sports Specific Training: Specialized strength, agility, and performance conditioning for athletes.
- Full Body Stretching: Guided static and dynamic stretching sessions for mobility, flexibility, and post-workout recovery.
- Strength & Conditioning: Progressive strength building, hypertrophy, and functional endurance training.
- Weight Loss Coaching: Comprehensive body transformation programs combining target workouts and lifestyle guidance.
- General Membership: Access to state-of-the-art strength equipment, cardio zone, and open workout floor.
